title: Fallout 3
notes: Vault reads the top of your save games (Documents\My Games\Fallout3\Saves) and never touches the game.
Places count when you have a save made there. Fallout 3 autosaves when you travel, so most places pop by themselves. Your highest level and longest play time across all saves count.
Saves you already have count too.

testGuide.title: Make a save
testGuide.detail: Play until you can save, then save from the pause menu. "Last save" should show your character, level and location.

testGuide.title: Reach Megaton
testGuide.detail: Save inside Megaton. "Atomic Neighbours" should pop up.
